mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_account, member_password, member_name, member_gender, member_age, member_height, member_weight, member_phone, card_time, card_class, card_next_class, card_expire_date, avatar) VALUES (#{memberAccount}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberGender}, #{memberAge}, #{memberHeight}, #{memberWeight}, #{memberPhone}, #{cardTime}, #{cardClass}, #{cardNextClass}, #{cardExpireDate}, #{avatar})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_password = #{memberPassword}, member_name = #{memberName}, member_gender = #{memberGender}, member_age = #{memberAge}, member_height = #{memberHeight}, member_weight = #{memberWeight}, member_phone = #{memberPhone}, card_time = #{cardTime}, card_class = #{cardClass}, card_next_class = #{cardNextClass}, card_expire_date = #{cardExpireDate}, avatar = #{avatar} WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount}

UPDATE member SET member_name = #{memberName}, member_gender = #{memberGender}, member_age = #{memberAge}, member_height = #{memberHeight}, member_weight = #{memberWeight}, member_phone = #{memberPhone}, avatar = #{avatar} WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount}
UPDATE member SET card_next_class = card_next_class - 1 WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount} AND card_next_class > 0
UPDATE member SET card_next_class = card_next_class + 1 WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount}
UPDATE member SET member_password = #{password} WHERE member_account = #{memberAccount}
